name: Courtside Deck

direction.name: framed-sheet
direction.basis: Only approved C1 v3 iterated. Original repaired embedded font assets, fixture and synthetic frame retained.

changes: Editor pill opens a distinct, internally scrollable representation of the existing compact Android timeline Editor.

Add missing rally is a separate explicit source-scrubber route. Cancel creates nothing; Add creates one local synthetic rally containing the sought point, clipped to source/gap bounds with a 500 ms minimum.

Editor, Review, Browse and Bounds share rally selection, inclusion, serving side, core bounds and source clock. Editor also supports local per-rally padding, splitting, preview and honest export sequence previews.
Workspace return preserves prior Review/Browse/Bounds and Bounds return destination. Browse list scroll, center marker, collapse and manual-follow state survive workspace switches.
Existing v3 rally-first appearance, progress, exact four 1 s edge actions, draggable bounds, dual source/list markers, gap highlight, review completion and Reset preserved.

routes.add-missing: Explicit missing-rally flow with source scrubber; returns to its origin

layout.editorScrolling: Internal vertical workspace plus capped All rallies list

inventory: Synthetic Practice match project and one 26 minute source.
36 chronological fixture rallies, including four overlapping clip/serve review items.
Cedar and Harbor synthetic team scores.
R018 starts selected at 9:8 and 770400 ms source time.
Shared included/removed, clip review and near/far/review serve fields.
Shared millisecond core bounds and optional Editor padding fields.
Browse source position and independent viewport-center rally midpoint.
Local additions and splits marked as synthetic added rallies.
Source gaps are explicit opportunities for Add missing.
All totals computed from the shared local data.

tasteReceipt.face: Preserved IBM Plex Sans and C1 framed sheet. Recognizable existing Editor palette and hierarchy only inside the Editor route.
tasteReceipt.signature: Rally-first source-proportional rail with independent playback dot and list-center diamond; existing Editor has two half-source timeline rows.

questions.rallies: What decision or trim does this rally need?
questions.editor: Which source clip or edit needs adjustment?
questions.add-missing: Where is the missing rally in this source gap?

tasteReceipt.idea: The scored rally becomes the unit of review on the Courtside Deck; the same rally is editable in the existing compact source timeline.

critique.hierarchy: Rallies retains the large synthetic video and immediate decisions. Existing Editor intentionally keeps the requested long-form hierarchy.
critique.edges: App is exactly 390 × 844, fluid to 360, centered at 768. No horizontal overflow across any route.
critique.colour: C1 teal retained in Rallies. Existing Editor uses authorized paper, ink, green and orange, with a darker orange heading for readable contrast.
critique.numbers: Source, scores, selected index, included counts and preview durations derive from shared data. Fonts render all original weights.
critique.states: Gap add highlights, disabled add inside an existing rally, minimum-length rejection, Cancel, completion and Reset verified.
critique.legends: Core, padding, review and serve legend swatches match their source-row marks.
critique.phone: Internal Editor scrolling reaches Game timeline, Selected rally, marking tools and All rallies at 360 and 390.

tasteReceipt.remainingVisualLimitation: Compact reference metadata uses small text; the inspector reports one defended tiny-text warning. No unresolved FAIL findings.

isolationReceipt.sharedBootstrap: Read SHARED_AGENTS.md completely and INDEX.md. User Taste-only instruction overrides the shared default to load both design skills.
isolationReceipt.skill: Taste SKILL.md and its full app-screens reference; own required lint, inspect and Browser/Page helper scripts.
authorizedInputs: Supplied existing compact Editor source excerpts
Both supplied existing Editor screenshots, inspected with image viewer
isolationReceipt.referenceException: User explicitly authorized existing Editor references for this v4 route. Earlier no-existing-UI restriction was superseded only for these supplied references.
isolationReceipt.writes: Only this v4 artifact directory, its .gitignore and ignored .process evidence. Temporary isolated browser profiles used outside the repository.

limitations: Synthetic local playback and sequence previews; no backend, native launch or real video export.
Project switching, source relink and extra-footage exclusion are honest preview dialogs.

assets.frame: Original synthetic code-drawn volleyball frame from approved baseline; no screenshot or real footage embedded.
assets.font: Original 400/500/600 IBM Plex Sans font assets, unchanged; SIL OFL 1.1 in FONT-LICENSES.txt.
